name: Day One
tagline: The visible digital journal loop is buildable, but a credible replacement needs more than the first screen. Day One earns its keep through polish, sync, importers, so expect a weekend or multi-day build and a narrower personal scope.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Day One costs $4.17/mo ($50.04/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
